lead_raw_text:
The structure of composition Sm4Cu6Ge8 (reduced formula Sm2Cu3Ge4) crystallizes in the trigonal space group P-31c (No. 143), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Ge centers each with a close-packed-like local arrangement of 12 neighbors, while Sm centers have 16 neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.68 to 3.87 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between 12-vertex Cu and 12-vertex Ge polyhedra, as well as corner- and face-sharing among Ge polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites.
